sections.text: The job queue is now Postgres-backed instead of Redis. Same API, same worker code.
It has been live in production since Thursday morning. Redis is still running but nothing writes to it.
If you enqueue jobs, drop the `priority` argument — it is ignored now and will be removed next week.
Anyone on call should watch the `jobs_pending` gauge rather than the Redis list length.
We were paying for two sources of truth and losing jobs whenever Redis evicted under memory pressure.
